scene_prompt: Modern school sports day. Two connected moments in one clear picture: small soft-edged inset at upper left shows a child wildly jumping for joy after winning a plain gold medal, landing awkwardly on one ankle. MAIN scene shows same child moments later sitting safely on a sturdy bench, medal still around neck, now tearful and regretful, while coach calmly wraps the mildly sprained ankle and applies a cold pack. Friend offers comfort. Strong visible emotional turn from excessive celebration to sadness caused by careless jumping, not simply losing a competition. No blood bruises graphic injury or alarming pain, gentle safe first aid. Anatomically correct leg bent comfortably with foot supported on low stool, correct hands and wraps, no twisted impossible joints. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no letters numbers logos brands watermarks or readable text.
alt: 贏得獎牌的孩子先前興奮跳起，卻落地扭傷腳踝，如今戴著獎牌坐在長椅上流淚，教練幫他冰敷包紮。
